HomePage.beachSearchTitle: Find a beach to your taste
HomePage.beachSearchDescription: Looking for the perfect beach? Use advanced filters and quickly find the ideal location! Browse by beach type, sand type, accessibility, popularity, activities, infrastructure and more. Whether you want a quiet corner to relax or a lively beach with numerous water sports, you'll easily find what suits you best.
HomePage.worldMapTitle: Browse the map with over 1500 beaches
HomePage.worldMapDescription: Discover the most beautiful beaches around the world with an interactive map containing over 1500 stunning locations. Whether you're looking for sandy paradise shores, hidden coves, or popular surfing destinations, you'll find the perfect beach for you. Check descriptions, ratings, and photos to plan your next dream seaside adventure!
HomePage.accommodationDescription: Experience perfect relaxation in accommodation right by the sea! Choose from luxury resorts, charming bungalows, or apartments with ocean views. Regardless of your travel style, comfort, beach proximity, and an unforgettable seaside experience await you.

Metadata.title: BeachRex - Find your perfect beach.
Metadata.description: All the beaches of the world in one place. For every tourist to find his or hers perfect beach for their earned vacation. This is the vision of BeachRex that I dedicated 4 years of my life to. During this time that I've travelled, I've created world's largest database of photos, videos, panoramas, sperichal photos and data on beaches of Spain, France, Slovenia, Croatia and Italy. Currently, I am creating a final website and mobile application with a complete presentation of all 2.445 beaches, 56.000 photos, videos, panoramas, spherical photos and 200 detailed data e.g. charasteristics of every beach. BeachRex's vision is that within few years we will obtain photos and other data for all the beaches of the world. If you love beaches and you like BeachRex's idea please support us and share our site with your friends.
